_readme: S613 SkyCometa, 2026-11-09. College of the Redwoods: 53 of 73 passing. Its 8 local A.S./A.A. degrees (e.g. 44463 Personal Wellness A.S., 18231 Liberal Arts: Business) name the 60 and no GE pattern or units, and read unequal. S608's read (42479757804) found the CR-GE page grad4 linked from every program page, and found grad5 (Cal-GETC) rendered only its menu. This read loads grad4 and grad2 (Graduation Requirements for Degrees and Certificates) directly, records what their own scripts fetch from eLumen's API, and prints the stretches of eLumen's page data (api-prod.elumenapp.com, catalog/sites/publish) around the words that carry units and degree rules: run 42538790768 showed the page text sits in that 2.9 MB body past its opening, and the follow pattern only matched course titles, so a reconcile step can cite the catalog's own CR-GE units and its local-degree rule. No model call. Run 42539434482 showed the publish body is a shell ("Loading") that names a contentUrl the page never fetched, so this read loads the two content addresses themselves.

questions.crge_units: The units the catalog states for the College of the Redwoods General Education Pattern (CR-GE), and whether it prints a 60-unit minimum, an electives rule or a major minimum for local A.S. and A.A. degrees.
